Submission Instructions

  1. Encode a TEI header for your witness by hand in witness.xml: title, publication statement, and an <msDesc> with <msIdentifier> (repository and shelfmark), a short physical description and history.
  2. Link the repository or author to an authority file (VIAF or Library of Congress) where one exists.
  3. Ask an AI model to produce a header for the same document, and write a short comparison of its version with yours (no minimum length): what it added, what it got wrong, and what you will change.
